interface.longDescription: Principal Driven Domain Design: principal-level domain architecture, reusable engines, module gap tracing, and explicit agent handoffs. By Lex from SigmaStudioz. Domain-first structure, scoped services/shared modules, cohesive engines, and evidence-based verification. Automatic use requires native global instructions. Historical Claude Code 1.0.5 evidence with the optional handoff guard passed 16/16 external feature checks and 2/2 regressions using one teammate. Native global setup is opt-in; instructions do not guarantee every model or runtime follows every rule. Version 1.1.0 adds cross-module edge checks, staged snapshot review and candidate-disproof guidance; no fresh native-agent efficacy run is claimed.
